provenance.source: new: 2026-10-24 real-host bug. A "theme" key in OpenCode's cli.json (any string value) silently turned Murmo off on OpenCode 2.1.x: OpenCode decodes cli.json as a whole and ignores all of it when one key has the wrong shape, and Murmo registered itself in that same file
provenance.author: murmo

cases.note: With the user's cli.json holding a string theme, a starter shortcut still expands: Murmo no longer depends on OpenCode reading cli.json.
